pages.title: About
pages.content: Shizuka Hearing was founded in 2014 by Dr. Elena Varga, a clinical audiologist who left a hospital ENT department to open a clinic where a fitting takes the time it needs. The rooms are on the second floor of 18 Harbour Lane, Northgate, with lift access from the street.

pages.title: Hearing Check
pages.content: A hearing check takes 60 minutes and covers conversation, otoscopy, and pure-tone audiometry. A diagnostic assessment takes 90 minutes and adds a speech-in-noise test. The hearing check is €95 and the diagnostic assessment is €160.

pages.title: Fitting Method
pages.content: Fitting uses real-ear measurement, with a thin probe tube at the ear, across two visits and a 14-day home trial on loaner devices. Fitting and real-ear verification is €380.

pages.title: Tinnitus Care
pages.content: A tinnitus consultation with Mei Lin Hartmann lasts 75 minutes, with sound therapy, counselling and a follow-up at 4 weeks. It is €140. No cure is claimed; many people find the sound becomes less intrusive.

pages.title: Aftercare & Review
pages.content: Review visits are booked at 2 weeks, 6 weeks, and 6 months, then yearly. Each lasts 45 minutes. The first two are included with every fitting; later visits are €60.

pages.title: Fees
pages.content: Hearing check €95. Diagnostic assessment €160. Fitting and real-ear verification €380. Review visit €60. Tinnitus consultation €140. Custom musician’s earplugs €210. Cleaning and re-tune €35.

pages.title: Audiologists
pages.content: Dr. Elena Varga, Samuel Okafor, Mei Lin Hartmann, Tomás Reyes, Claire Dubois, Jonas Lindqvist and Priya Nair see patients at 18 Harbour Lane.

pages.title: Stories
pages.content: Martin, Henrik and Ana describe what changed for them. Experiences differ, and none of these accounts is a promise of a result.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content: Questions about hearing checks, fittings, the 14-day home trial and review visits are answered here.

pages.title: Visit & Contact
pages.content: 18 Harbour Lane, Northgate, 2nd floor, lift access. Phone +00 555 0184. Email hello@shizuka-hearing.example. Monday to Friday 9:00–18:00, Thursday until 20:00, Saturday 9:00–13:00. Closed Sunday and public holidays.
